pairs.why: B's locomotive is a solid, fully built engine with a grille cowcatcher, tender and soft-shaded detail, like the bus and bike cards; A looks like a chunky toy with a flat slab front.
A has the real cards' three-quarter scene staging, a full desert setting and calmer, softer shading; B is a flatter side view with brighter, more plastic red trim.
B's tilted star has softer, more matte gold and a smaller gem, closer to the trumpet and medal cards; A is more saturated and glossy, with a big shiny faceted jewel.
